expiryInfo.explanation: SEBI mandates weekly contracts ONLY on Nifty (17-Nov). BankNifty has NO weekly contracts and trades strictly on Monthly Expiry (23-Nov)!

strategyRules.stopLossRule: Strict 25% Stop-Loss on individual sold leg
strategyRules.hedgeBenefit: Buy OTM wings to reduce SEBI margin to ~₹48,500 - ₹55,000 per lot
strategyRules.executionSequence: STEP 1: Buy Hedges (Leg 3 & 4) -> STEP 2: Sell Main Strikes (Leg 1 & 2)
